Actor Mohanlal's ivory possession case resurfaces

Malayalam actor Mohanlal has brought his decade-old ivory possession case back into focus by applying to the Kerala Forest Department under a one-time declaration scheme. The case involves the actor's declaration of possessing elephant tusks and ivory idols. The matter has been in court for several years, and his recent action has reopened discussions about the legalities and the ongoing trial.
